outcome: cholesterol synthesis-related proteins (SREBP2, HMGCR, HMGCS) expression
cohort: Patients who underwent abortion at 6-10 weeks of gestation, divided into cesarean scar pregnancy (CSP), normal intrauterine pregnancy without history of cesarean section (NP), and normal intrauterine pregnancy after cesarean section (NPACS) groups.
finding: Women with cesarean scar pregnancy (CSP) had significantly higher expression of PAR-1, MCP-1, CCR2, SREBP2, HMGCR, and HMGCS in blood and decidual stromal cells, along with significantly higher total blood cholesterol levels, compared to women with normal intrauterine pregnancies.
mod_finding: The expression of PAR-1, MCP-1, CCR2, SREBP2, HMGCR, and HMGCS was not significantly different between normal intrauterine pregnancies with and without a history of cesarean section.
